attributes.action: Earned settlement should be fair for all skilled workers And 5 Years ILR
attributes.additional_details: Earned settlement , we appreciate carers getting ILR in 5 years as they deserve it . However, Low skilled workers known ILR after 5 years and taken their lifetime decision to change their lives too and came in Uk ,work hard ,pay taxes, respect culture and make their home and serve the community . Skilled workers earning less than £50000 they deserve the ILR as well. It is obvious discrimination between Carees and Low skilled workers.
attributes.background: All skilled workers should be treated with the same way . Everyone’s work hard to settle down themselves for better future. In half way they should not betrayed. ILR should be granted 5 years for low skilled workers with less than £50000 earning as Careers deserve .

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Protect the five-year ILR route for existing Skilled Workers" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785621
